item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination accepting the agreement and terminates the Section 301 investigation; the legal consequence occurs in this segment rather than through a later agency decision.","evidence":"I have determined to accept the agreement described below as an appropriate and feasible action to resolve this investigation and therefore to terminate the investigation."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the USTR to give notice and undertake implementation and monitoring, without dictating a separate later legal outcome affecting rights or obligations.","evidence":"I direct the United States Trade Representative (USTR) to notify the Government of Korea of my approval of the agreement and to take any actions necessary to implement and monitor it."},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the substantive statutory Section 301 determination concerning Korea's trade restrictions; the remaining text explains the agreement and its anticipated foreign implementation.","evidence":"I have determined that these restrictions were unjustifiable, unreasonable, or discriminatory and a burden or restriction on U.S commerce."}]}
